intro: Starfall Village is a tranquil night elven sanctuary nestled along the snowy road of Winterspring. As the sole Alliance outpost in the frozen valley, it offers shelter and supplies to travelers braving the bitter northern chill. It also stands watch over the nearby barrow den.

sections.t: An Alliance Refuge in the Snow
p: Situated northwest of the goblin trading post of Everlook and south of Frostsaber Rock, Starfall Village represents the lone bastion of Alliance civilization in Winterspring. Composed of traditional night elven timber lodges, the settlement serves as a haven for wayfarers, providing critical supplies and a warm hearth amid the harsh mountain elements. Despite its peaceful appearance, the village remains ever vigilant, positioned adjacent to a quiet, unoccupied barrow den.
